verdict.rationale: Slack has no documented native version history, review, or rollback for automations. The closest support is indirect: workflows can be written as TypeScript code with the Deno Slack SDK and managed through the Slack CLI, so they could be kept in external source control. Developer sandboxes also let teams build and test without putting production at risk. Missing for 10: native workflow version history, a built-in review/approval flow for automation changes, documented rollback for Workflow Builder or deployed workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
